method: TF-IDF of words and word pairs (negation marked), multinomial logistic regression, Adam, L2, balanced class weights

data.name: TweetEval, sentiment task (SemEval-2017 Task 4)
data.citation: Barbieri, Camacho-Collados, Espinosa-Anke and Neves (2020). TweetEval: Unified Benchmark and Comparative Evaluation for Tweet Classification. Findings of EMNLP 2020.
limitations: English tweets from 2013–2017 (SemEval): Kiswahili, Sheng and Kenyan slang are not represented, so results on them are weaker and were not measured.
Labels describe the tone of a tweet, not whether it is true, harmful or coordinated.
Sarcasm and irony are often misread.
